But wait — the grab zone! In run 2, the M at (39,40) couldn't be moved with a click at (35,38) (distance to ball center 9.4). The ball center is (27,33). My step 2 click (33,37): distance to ball center = (6,4)=7.2 — inside the zone! The TR marker at center (37,41) is 12.0 from the ball center. Hmm, in run 2 the M at center (40,41) (15.3 from the ball center) couldn't be grabbed with a click at (35,38) (9.4 from the ball center).
But in run 2, the TL marker was dragged from center (36,26) with a click at (31,32) (distance to ball center (4,1)=4.1!) — deep inside the zone — and it worked. At that point the ball had an inner M.
The difference: maybe the grab zone only blocks when the ball has no inner piece? Run 2 timeline:
- TR absorption (ball empty → inner M): the p was dragged with a click at the foot (30,34) — worked on an empty ball.
- TL absorption (ball had inner M): click at the foot (31,32) — worked.
- After that, the ball had inner p. Clicks at (33,37), (35,38) near the M at (39,40) — failed.

- Click (23,33) — moved p to the top of the ball.

At (35,38): M Δ5.8, inner p Δ6.4 — M is closer but the inner p won (nothing moved… hmm, actually neither moved).
Confusing. But the key point: in the fresh run, the first two absorptions worked with clicks at the foot on an empty ball and a ball with an inner M. The failures happened later with the inner p. Maybe the inner p (3×3) has a larger grab radius and blocks.
For my plan: steps 2-3 (TR marker, ball empty) — worked in run 2 (the TR p was absorbed with a foot click on an empty ball). Steps 5-6 (TL marker, ball has inner M) — worked in run 2. Step 11 (3rd absorption, ball has inner p) — this is the risky one; in run 2 the inner p blocked the external M. If the M is within 8 of the foot, the M is closer than the inner p (the inner p is at the foot center (31,33); the M is at, say, (31,31) → the M is 2 from the click (31,31), the inner p is 2 from the click… a tie).

A new p (from token+marker) was absorbed without issue (TR). So the 3rd piece could be a new p: stamp a token, merge with a marker, drag to the foot. But that's more actions.
Or maybe the 3rd absorption works fine with a bare M — the run 2 failure might have been due to the M being out of range (11.4 > 8), not a block.
Let me also reconsider: the goal might not be 3 absorptions. It might be: the inner icon must become Y 4×4 (3 absorptions) — same thing. Or the Y piece must be dragged to the HUD.
Anyway, let's start executing and observe. First action: click the TR dot (37,41) to spawn the marker. Actually wait — the dot positions in the current frame: S dots at (37,18), (37,41), (40,37), (41,16), (54,49), (55,14), (56,47), (57,16).

OK, let me start: click (37,41).
